[b]Court case ageinst Abd al-Hakim.[/b]
The court case ageinst Abd al-Hakim continues with an ever increasing burden of evidence being levied towards him that not only proves wihtout a doupt that he was not only working together with the Sal-baliz terrorist organization but was a high renking member within the organization itself.
This have caused some to be outraged that the man was not only allowed to live within Nordiheims borders but even able to attain any type of citizenship, a Nordlandian one at that.
[i]The regional goverment of Nordland have stated that they will do an investigation to find out how he managed to do this.[/i]
Some are calling the whole legal court case "unnecessary" as he is clearly guilty and deserving of joust being executed immidiatly so no more tax payer money is wasted on him.

[b]Concerning missile discovery.[/b]
Though in a recent search trough Abd al-Hakims vacation home on the Nordlandian coast a rather disturbing discovery was made, the house had a large secret underground complex.
This secret underground complex is belived to be a old and forgoten underground shelter, hailing all they way back to the "Long War of Continuation" in the early 1700s, that was secretly renovated and expanded trough the use of eager Sal-baliz recruits before they got sendt to Sal-baliz to recive "combat" training.
While a lot of new evidence was uncovered there about Abd al-Hakims involvement and position in Sal-baliz, as well as information about what movements and plans they had for Nordiheim, the most disturbing and concerning ting was the discovery of several missiles and even a warhead that should have been impossible to find there.

Many older models of anti-ship and even some 'Malingee' cruise missiles was uncovered, together with a actual 'Garkain Balistic missile' warhead.
Not only should there not be any 'Malingee' cruise missiles unacounted for but the 'Garkain' warhead should have been impossible to acquire for anyone outside of the Nordiheims military, as they are at the time not sold to any other nation and are strictly controlled and guarded.
This discovery, together with the recent news that the Al-Nuzzrat Et-Sham Brigade appears to have some how managed to acquire 'Malingee' cruise missiles, indicate that a large and potentialy severe breach of security have happened some were in the "production and delivery chain" of Nordiheims missile industry have occourred.
It is heavely suspected that the [b]'unknown group'[/b] that was going to help the Sal-baliz terrorist group creat a new terrorist cell in Nordiheim is at the hearth of all of this. 

The council of Nordiheim is taking this news with extreme seriousness and have ordered a large investigation into how this have happened aswell as why this had not been discovered, this investigation will not only be done by the Nordiheim military and security agencies but also an elite element of the councils own "shadow keepers".
They have also sent a request to King Ibrahim I Al-Baliz of [nation]Sal-baliz[/nation] and the THEP organization to allow their agents to investigate the weapons and munitions stockpiles left over from the Sal-baliz terrorist organization to see if any Nordiheimian weapons or amunition managed to arrive to them.

[quote=astanir;60360629][spoiler=[b]The war progresses[/b]]
As the situation in Astanir continues to spiral and escalate, several advances and losses have been made as the war continues into 2026.

[b]In the east - [nation]Qianxun[/nation[/b]
On the eastern side of the island, Democratic forces continue to make advances with the help of Qianxun and pax international. A successful offensive has brought more coastline under the control of Democratic forces, as well as securing the southern exclave. This further allowed democratic forces to split off the junta forces and begin an offensive against their trapped forces, as well as begin descending upon the surrounded nationalist-held city of Zasuro. 

Additionally, waves of men have been poured into the long northern frontlines, allowing the democratic forces to make a slow, attritional advance towards the main strongholds of the junta forces.

[b]Argossian advances - [nation]nordiheim[/nation][/b]
On the other side of the island, negotiations would go well between the argossians and nordiheimians. The three main tribes of the island had for the first time in a century worked together successfully. A push by all sides towards each other would result in the creation of a coherent territory for the argossian militias.

The next step would be to unite the various tribes under one government. Talks have begun, but are progressing slowly due to each tribe having their own distinct identity, yet still sharing a common enemy and a common goal.

Meawhile, on the lower islands the efforts of the Nordiheimian shadow keepers had payed off. Negotiations and persuasion had informed the tribes of the islands of the current situation and convinced them to stage an uprising. On the 1st January 2026, as new year celebrations commenced and the junties let their guard down, the Sulwik-Et-Hamanar tribe, using Nordiheimian intelligence and equipment, launched an offensive against several junta military bases, establishing a foothold on the lower island of akmazchi and dealing a horrible blow to the reputation and credibility of the junta.

[b]Southern discontent - [nation]pantagruel[/nation[/b]
On the amaralan islands, the people's army would make a major offensive against the junta, capturing the rest of the archipelago in under a day. They would begin preparing a naval task force for an invasion of the main island, feeling hopeful as negotiations with pantagruel prepared to go ahead. However, panic struck when an air attack began across the islands.

Initially, it was suspected to be an attack by Arenenge or another Amaralan power opposed to pantagruel, but upon examination using data from radars before they were destroyed, it shocked the faction to discover that they had just been attacked by Pantagruel itself.

The 40-year-old antiair equipment would be no match for Pantagruel's air superiority aircraft. Airbases and air defences would be decimated in minutes, giving the amaralans no time to react and respond. With imminent destruction coming their way, it would be made clear to the diplomats that peace had to be secured with Pantagruel...
[/spoiler]

current situation mapped: https://imgur.com/a/1h4bdKc[/quote]

[spoiler=Nordiheimian moves]
[b][u]The 3 main tribes of Astanir:[/u][/b]
Whit the successfull joining of the three fronts of the Argossian militias in north-western Astanir the Nordiheimians decided that the time to increase their support to them was right.
Using the fact that the logistics network was being constantly being improved by the effort of the local Argossians and Nordiheimian opratives shipments of more equipment and supplies would be sent together with new vehicles like the AFV-5G105 Cassowary, Platypus 1B and different versions of the AIS-Corp. AC-4B, this would enable greater power for the militia to defend and attack.
-The Cassowary would provide them with a fast vehicle equiped with a powerfull gun that with LAHAT rounds would be a treath even to newer heavely protected armored vehicles.
-Meanwhile the Platypus would provide a good all around APC that also came as heavy mortar carriers and comand vehicles for more organized mobile assult groups
-And the armored car AC-4B variants would provide both bether Anti-air ability to defend ageinst air treaths and ways of dealing with enemy formations containing mostly infantry and light vehicles with their rapid fire machine guns and chain guns.

A project was also proposed to the Argossian Militia of improving and upgrading 3 airfields to be able to opperate more modern aircraft such as fighter jets, ones they were compleat Nordiheim would be able to provide them with some of their older KJ-5H Cockatoo fighters to compeat for air dominance, or atleast deny it to their enemies.
They also informed them that there was Argossians back in Nordiheim that knew how to fly and operate them that were potentialy willing to join them as private mercenaries and foreign pilots to make this a reality.

A team was also sendt to try and help the different tribes to orgenize a goverment, with the Nordiheimian council as an example were each tribe could have a representative (minister) with equal power to avoid anyone from being compleatly disregarded in politics and matters of goverment that affected everyone.

Diplomatic talks were also done with [nation]Italian dutch[/nation] to potentialy cooperate in aiding their desire to provide the Argossian people of Astanir with food and medical supplies in these violent and trying times. 

[b][u]The lower islands:[/u][/b]
When Nordiheims Shadow Keepers informed them of the Sulwik-Et-Hamanar tribes successfull creation of a foothold on akmazchi island they wasted no time in sending ships of supplies, weapons and vehicles to them so that their position could be strenghtened and their attack could continue.
While most of this was of the lighter types of vehicles and weapons for easy transportation and logistics it was also decided to take a small gamble, since these islands were smaller and closer to Nordiheim it would be easier to help them with logistics using Nordiheims navy, as such some Iron Drake 2D main battle tanks would be sendt to them to provide a vehicle with thick and powerfull armor that might be to much for the local forces of the Armed Restoration Front to deal with, as any older tanks they might have would strugle to deal with them in any effective way.
Amphibious crafts and heavy rafts would also be provided for the local Argossians to enable them to get to the secound island.

News of the Sulwik-Et-Hamanar tribes success would also be spread to the Argossians on the neighboring island.

[b][u]The large Astanir island joust south-east of Italian dutch[/u][/b]
In the interest of finding out more about this island, wich is curently controlled by the Armed Restoration Front, Nordiheim would deploy agents to infiltrate this island to find out what exactly was there and what the situation was like.
These agents would be deployed at night from submarines to avoid detection.

[b][u]The central Argossian enclave on Astanir:[/u][/b]
The Argossian enclave in the central part of Astanir was of some concern to Nordiheim, as their situation of being sorounded by enemies could mean that their ability to get suplies and weapons would be difficult, as such a operation would be launched using the agents that had been deployed to infiltrate the factions of the Armed Restoration Front and Astaniran National Forces and areas around the enclave would be directed to execute an important mission code named "Sky Serpent".

At the same time of day the agenst would plant timed explosive devices on any radars, AA weapons and military airports to destroy or compremice them and their ability to defend the Astanir skies.
After this was done Nordiehim would start air dropping military supplies & munitions, infantry weapons, mortar launchers and mines together with shelf stable food and civilian suplies to the enclave wich would be cordinated with them trough the Nordiheimian agents that had been sendt to contact them.
Some sets of light weight comunication equipment would also be air droped inn to them so more propper comunication could be made between them and both Nordiheim and the other Argossian militias.

The planes that would do the air dropping would be followed by squads of fighter jets to keep them safe from any AA defences that could potentialy survive operation "Sky Serpent" or that they had managed to not find.
Inn adition there would be deployed 5 SD1-S Mook mook stealth drones to monitor the air missions and provide detection of any treaths, they would be followed by 2 mysterious aircraft that would be all but invisible to radar, these would strike down anyone who tried to attack the Nordiheimian aircrafts.

[b][u]The situations and happenings in the east and south:[/u][/b]
Agent reports from the Democratic Army of Astanir, aswell as military observations of happenings on the southern islands, would cause some allarm among Nordiheim military command, these were rather serious and direct actions by other nations.
As such orders was sendt to the Olian branch of the military to send a navy task force, containing their designated Battleship, down to join the "Astanir Navy Convoy Fleet" to strenghten their ability to guard the cargo and tanker ships being sailed trough the area towards the Astanir main island, both from navy treaths aswell as air treaths.

Though other then that they would not make any direct moves ageinst these nations, as Nordiheim were not yet [u]"technicaly"[/u] directly involved, joust [u]"providing[/u] suport".[/spoiler]
